annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence and Employment Futures for the Arab Region
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence and Employment Futures for the Arab Region
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UN ESCWA and ILO Regional Office for Arab States
annotation.summary_en: Joint ESCWA–ILO report on how AI will reshape employment, skills and productivity in the Arab region from 2025 to 2035. It uses modelling and strategic foresight with three 2035 scenarios, and recommends inclusive skills systems, lifelong learning and adaptive social protection. Embodied AI appears only in passing within a scenario.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI will affect both routine and higher-skilled cognitive jobs in the Arab region.
Strategic foresight with three alternative 2035 scenarios is proposed for policymaking.
Recommends inclusive skills systems, lifelong learning and adaptive social protection.
Notes nine Arab countries have national AI strategies and AI investment is accelerating, especially in the GCC.
Scenario B warns that fragmented reskilling and labour-law adaptation could widen equity gaps.
